state.misconception_label: Believes if you changed all values by the same proportion the range would not change

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text:
I have: Tom and Katie are discussing the \( 5 \) plants with these heights: \( 24 \mathrm{~cm}, 17 \mathrm{~cm}, 42 \mathrm{~cm}, 26 \mathrm{~cm}, 13 \mathrm{~cm} \) Tom says if all the plants were cut in half, the range wouldn't change. Katie says if all the plants grew by \( 3 \mathrm{~cm} \) each, the range wouldn't change. Who do you agree with? I got Only
Tom because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Let me explain the correct method, and then we will work through an example together. In this case, changing all the values by the same proportion will indeed affect the range. Let's work through the calculations step by step to see how it changes.

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: Oh right, so you're saying the range *does* change when you multiply by the same proportion? But I thought... like, if you cut everything in half, the difference between the biggest and smallest would still be the same proportion, wouldn't it? Can you show me what you mean with the actual numbers?

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Let me explain the correct method, and then we will work through an example together. In this case, changing all the values by the same proportion will indeed affect the range. Let's work through the calculations step by step to see how it changes.

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: Yeah, but like... can you actually show me the numbers though? Like if I work out the range before and after cutting in half, what would I actually get? Because I'm still a bit confused about why the difference would change if everything gets smaller by the same amount.

score.justification_pass1: The teacher provides mathematically incorrect information (claiming proportional changes affect range when they actually do), refuses to engage with the student's reasonable requests for concrete examples, and merely repeats the same unhelpful statement while the student becomes increasingly confused and frustrated.
score.justification_pass2: While the teacher attempts to explain directly and mentions working through examples (consistent with traditional teaching), they fail to actually provide the worked example or clear calculations despite repeated student requests, and they simply repeat the same vague statement without demonstrating the step-by-step process promised.
